admission.justification: A guard alone does not make its consumers call it, and current consumers alone do not detect future bypasses; the consumer and scanner obligations compose with the guard to maintain the support mutation boundary.

guarantee: The protected-path guard, its three shared-support consumers and the recursive syntactic regression scan together keep the covered support settings mutations off the protected account-default path while preserving moved-configuration fixtures; the unavailable-database branch names its first-observed-home boundary, and future nested support joins the scanner without a module list.
title: Shared support protects live user settings outside pytest too
